description: Fresh accuracy evidence on both platforms. Every upstream reference comparison from the complete 527-case grid, plus independently formulated physical/convergence and high-precision checks. Numerical failures are retained. No timing results are collected in this plan. The cluster-conditioning case and appended high-precision Wigner inputs are targeted diagnostics added after reference failures; they are not prespecified performance cases.

cases.selection: Post-failure diagnostic for scaling-cluster-n8-l8-s2048-t4 and scaling-cluster-n8-l12-s2048-t4. Original failed performance cases remain unchanged.
